note: Curated videos for video-library.html, watch.html?v=<slug> and <figure data-video="<slug>"> in lessons. Hand-edited; validate with npm run check:videos. Times are positions in the source video ("1:30"); start/end make a clip; pauses stop the video and show the question. Allowed sources: assets/js/video-sources.mjs.

groups.title: Science & Wonder
groups.sub: Cosmos, scale, and the patterns of nature

groups.title: Technology
groups.sub: How systems work and myths get busted

groups.title: Purpose & Voice
groups.sub: Resilience, creativity, and thinking for yourself

pale-blue-dot.title: Carl Sagan — Pale Blue Dot
pale-blue-dot.desc: Carl Sagan reflects on Earth seen from 3.7 billion miles away and what that perspective asks of us.
pale-blue-dot.insight: Use scale to deepen humility. Ask how scientific imagery can change ethical choices.

powers-of-ten.title: Powers of Ten (1977)
powers-of-ten.desc: The Eames Office film travels from a Chicago picnic to cosmic scale, then inward toward the atom.
powers-of-ten.insight: Build intuition for exponents and scientific notation. Pause to predict what the next power of ten will reveal.

nature-by-numbers.title: Nature by Numbers — 4K Remastered
nature-by-numbers.desc: An artist-made exploration of Fibonacci numbers, the golden ratio, and geometric patterns in living forms.
nature-by-numbers.insight: Treat the film as a mathematical claim, not proof. Ask students where the model fits nature and where it simplifies it.

what-is-the-internet.title: What Is the Internet?
what-is-the-internet.desc: A short introduction to the connected systems and shared protocols behind the internet.
what-is-the-internet.insight: Help students distinguish the internet from the web and identify the physical systems beneath a browser page.

jobs-on-failure.title: Steve Jobs on Failure
jobs-on-failure.desc: An archival interview excerpt about failure, iteration, and continuing to build.
jobs-on-failure.insight: Connect setbacks to revision. Ask what evidence would distinguish perseverance from repeating the same mistake.

jobs-secrets-of-life.title: Steve Jobs — Secrets of Life
jobs-secrets-of-life.desc: An archival interview excerpt about questioning assumptions and making useful things.
jobs-secrets-of-life.insight: Listen critically: which ideas are actionable, and which depend on privilege, context, or hindsight?
